scope: Conditional exits and blocker producers in the 16 composed pipeline modules. Not independent policy gate count. Action lists are domain bounds narrowed by enclosing predicates and the reviewed action-specific table in decibel_order_pipeline_audit_v1.md; not captured production evidence.

VENUE.evidence: Authenticated positions, residual open orders, fill/terminal history, account identity and original read windows.
VENUE.previous: No strategy/economic decision substitutes for venue integrity. Final freshness is checked again after awaits.
VENUE.suppression: May invalidate a plan based on stale or contradictory venue facts.

CAPACITY.evidence: Allocated collateral, current/pending exposure, available margin, leverage, minimum lots, certificate freshness and per-side sizing.
CAPACITY.previous: Planning computes a candidate; final admission recomputes current limits. This is intentional, not a second allocation.
CAPACITY.suppression: A current capacity/quantity limit can invalidate an earlier plan; free margin alone is insufficient.

STRATEGY.evidence: Canonical mode, inventory, residual coverage, desired versus resting orders, pending reservations and candidate economics.
STRATEGY.previous: Consumes validated venue/capacity inputs; action-specific branches are authoritative for intent generation.
STRATEGY.suppression: NO_OP/KEEP may mean no authorized mutation exists, even when an unpriced candidate differs.

AUTHORIZATION.evidence: Per-action fresh account/market/capacity evidence, candidate fee/gas/adverse economics, canonical reduction authorization, loss/target state.
AUTHORIZATION.previous: Rechecks a chosen candidate after planning. Entry economics is not canonical defensive eligibility.
AUTHORIZATION.suppression: WAIT/STOP must report its precise necessary reason. Selected PLACE now reports BLOCKED rather than silent HOLD.

DISPATCH.evidence: Selected action, exact resting identity, replacement benefit/age/sustained movement, frozen plan, refreshed read set and journal ownership.
DISPATCH.previous: Uses strategy authorization; commit revalidation after awaits is intentional. Former generic KEEP/all-blocked and discarded abort reasons are repaired.
DISPATCH.suppression: May suppress for changed evidence/ownership or insufficient economic benefit; no age-only replacement allowed.

PREFLIGHT.evidence: Tick/lot alignment, maker/IOC role, final current position, residual orders, no-flip, minimum size and current notional/position ceiling.
PREFLIGHT.previous: Source formerly ran this validator on fresh limits and Lifecycle repeated it on old planning limits. Source now returns fresh limits and Lifecycle validates once.
PREFLIGHT.suppression: Final current invariant violation blocks submission; older captured limits must not override the fresh final read set.

EXECUTION.evidence: Execution mode/config, durable identity claim, mutation budget, live-owner count, SDK outcome and reconciliation provenance.
EXECUTION.previous: Final claim/execution barriers are independent from candidate selection; none were removed.
EXECUTION.suppression: Duplicate/unknown ownership stays RECONCILING; final venue rejection is explicit, never assumed successful.

SESSION.evidence: PID/instance ownership, session status, persisted unwind, fresh flat checkpoint and zero unresolved intents.
SESSION.previous: Owns runtime activation/finalization, not trading economics. No automatic new sessions.
SESSION.suppression: An ended or unowned runtime cannot mutate, regardless of account margin.
